description: HySetter is a Python package built on the HyRiver software stack for extracting hydroclimate inputs over the conterminous United States. Its command-line and Python interfaces read a YAML configuration specifying an area of interest, data sources and an output directory. The repository lists river networks, meteorological forcing, streamflow, soils, terrain, dams and land-cover products among its supported inputs. These subsets can prepare catchment and environmental information for reservoir, water-supply or flood simulations. Spatial detail and available periods depend on the selected provider. Source code and examples are freely available on GitHub under MIT. A limitation is reliance on multiple external services, so an unchanged configuration does not guarantee identical data after provider updates. HyRiver is a separate G5 draft; no directly related existing catalogue record was established. This review read the documented interface and source list without downloading data or testing a complete subsetting run.
